title: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations
zh_title: 基于AI的肿瘤多学科会诊病例总结与建议的挑战
summary: 在四家机构数据上评估多种LLM于肿瘤会诊病例总结、方案生成和会议结局预测任务，总结评分较高，建议生成更困难。
key_points: 肿瘤内科医生创建约9.6k参考文本、16k人工评判
评估DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini、Qwen系列模型
reason: 四机构数据、大规模专家评估，含人机对照，属重要档
abstract: Tumor boards, recurring meetings at hospital institutions, assemble cancer specialists (e.g., medical oncology and pathology) to discuss patient care. In this work, we formally define tumor board case summarization, options generation, and meeting outcome prediction as AI tasks. We study datasets from four medical institutions and evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) from the DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen families using expert human assessment. Medical oncologists created ~9.6k reference texts and 16k human judgments across tasks. Clinicians rated LLM-generated case summaries 3.57–4.59 out of 5.0 across institutions, but recommendation generation remained more challenging, with average scores of 2.0–3.6. Clinical alignment analyses showed modest correlations of ~0.2 for case summarization subtasks and higher correlations of ~0.6 for recommendation generation using LLM-as-Judge metrics. Our proposed TBFact metrics were competitive with LLM-as-Judge approaches in longer prose free-text settings, suggesting a promising direction toward explainable evaluation. This study, to our knowledge the largest expert-grading study of tumor board tasks with both granular and direct assessments, found that criterion-level scores and overall judgments are related nonlinearly. Experts also frequently assigned high ratings to responses that differed substantially from their reference texts, challenging assumptions underlying reference-based automatic evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤多学科会诊（tumor board）是医院机构中定期召开的会议，汇集癌症专科医生（如肿瘤内科和病理科）讨论患者的诊疗。在本研究中，我们将肿瘤多学科会诊的病例摘要、备选方案生成和会议结果预测正式定义为人工智能任务。我们研究了来自四家医疗机构的数据集，并通过专家人工评估，对来自 DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini 和 Qwen 系列的最先进大语言模型（LLM）进行了评价。肿瘤内科医生在各项任务中共创建了约 9.6k 条参考文本和 16k 条人工评判。各机构的临床医生对 LLM 生成的病例摘要评分为 3.57–4.59（满分 5.0），但推荐意见生成仍更具挑战性，平均得分为 2.0–3.6。临床一致性分析显示，病例摘要各子任务的相关性较弱，约为 0.2；而使用 LLM-as-Judge 指标时，推荐意见生成的相关性较高，约为 0.6。我们提出的 TBFact 指标在较长的散文式自由文本场景中与 LLM-as-Judge 方法相比具有竞争力，提示了一个有前景的可解释评估方向。据我们所知，本研究是迄今规模最大的、同时包含细粒度评估和直接评估的肿瘤多学科会诊任务专家评分研究，发现标准层面的评分与总体评判之间呈非线性关系。专家还经常对与其参考文本差异很大的回答给予高分，这对基于参考文本的自动评估指标所依据的假设提出了挑战。

title: Multimodal AI-enabled repurposing and prioritization of ferroptosis-targeting drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma

summary: FeNetDP整合多组学与临床生存数据，筛选胰腺导管腺癌中靶向铁死亡抑制程序的可重定位药物组合，并进行了前瞻性实验验证。

abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) lacks scalable and mechanism-informed computational strategies for prioritizing repurposable drug combinations. Here, we developed FeNetDP, a multimodal AI-guided framework that integrates transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial, and clinical survival data to enable biologically grounded drug repurposing and combination prioritization in PDAC. FeNetDP combines gene-level network proximity analysis with a biologically constrained neural ranking model to identify candidate compounds and drug pairs linked to a disease-relevant ferroptosis suppressor program. Using this framework, we defined an eight-gene ferroptosis suppressor module enriched in ductal cells and associated with poor prognosis, and prioritized candidate repurposable compounds and combinations targeting this network state. Prospective experimental validation identified panobinostat plus sorafenib as a synergistic combination that suppresses tumor growth and promotes ferroptosis in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, the combination impaired ferroptosis resistance through coordinated disruption of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense and AIFM2 (FSP1)-associated glutathione-independent protection. Together, these findings establish FeNetDP as a multimodal and experimentally grounded framework for computational repurposing and mechanism-informed therapeutic prioritization in cancer.
zh_abstract: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）缺乏可扩展且基于机制的计算策略来优先筛选可重新利用的药物组合。在此，我们开发了 FeNetDP，这是一个多模态、由 AI 引导的框架，整合转录组、蛋白质组、单细胞、空间和临床生存数据，以实现 PDAC 中基于生物学的药物重新利用和联合用药优先排序。FeNetDP 将基因水平的网络邻近性分析与受生物学约束的神经网络排序模型相结合，以识别与疾病相关的铁死亡抑制程序相关的候选化合物和药物对。利用该框架，我们定义了一个在导管细胞中富集且与不良预后相关的八基因铁死亡抑制模块，并优先筛选出针对该网络状态的候选可重新利用化合物及其组合。前瞻性实验验证发现，帕比司他（panobinostat）联合索拉非尼（sorafenib）为一种协同组合，在体外和体内均可抑制肿瘤生长并促进铁死亡。机制上，该组合通过协同破坏谷胱甘肽依赖的抗氧化防御以及 AIFM2（FSP1）相关的非谷胱甘肽依赖保护，削弱了铁死亡抵抗。综上，这些发现确立了 FeNetDP 作为一个多模态且有实验依据的框架，可用于癌症中的计算药物重新利用和基于机制的治疗优先排序。

abstract: Infantile retinal diseases are a leading cause of childhood blindness, and vascular findings that guide screening and management are often poorly visible in color fundus photography (CFP). Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) provides angiographic visualization of retinal vascular abnormalities, but its invasive nature and reliance on fluorescein dye limit routine use in vulnerable infants. Generative synthesis may provide non-invasive angiographic approximations. However, infant imaging often relies on manually operated handheld contact fundus cameras, with variations in probe angle, contact pressure, and field of view between separate CFP and FFA acquisitions contributing to weak spatial correspondence between modalities. In this paper, we present InfantAngio, a diffusion-based framework that reformulates CFP-to-FFA synthesis as a deterministic latent transport trajectory. Developed and evaluated using 83,950 registration-derived image-pair records from 259 infants, InfantAngio showed favorable performance across quantitative image-quality benchmarks, while ophthalmologists distinguished real from synthesized FFA images with near-chance accuracy of 49.8% in blinded assessment. Adding synthesized FFA to CFP improved both downstream classifier performance and overall diagnostic accuracy in a retrospective ophthalmologist reader study. These results support synthesized FFA as a potentially useful non-invasive adjunct for screening high-risk infants, with the possibility of reducing reliance on dye-based procedures in real-world clinical scenarios.
zh_abstract: 婴儿视网膜疾病是儿童致盲的主要原因，而指导筛查和处理的血管表现在彩色眼底照相（CFP）中往往难以清晰显示。荧光素眼底血管造影（FFA）可对视网膜血管异常提供血管造影可视化，但其有创性及对荧光素染料的依赖限制了其在脆弱婴儿中的常规应用。生成式合成可能提供无创的血管造影近似图像。然而，婴儿成像常依赖人工操作的手持接触式眼底相机，分别采集的 CFP 与 FFA 之间探头角度、接触压力和视野存在差异，导致两种模态之间的空间对应较弱。本文提出 InfantAngio，一种基于扩散的框架，将 CFP 到 FFA 的合成重新表述为确定性的潜空间传输轨迹。InfantAngio 基于来自 259 名婴儿的 83,950 条配准衍生的图像对记录进行开发和评估，在定量图像质量基准上表现良好，而在盲法评估中，眼科医生区分真实与合成 FFA 图像的准确率为 49.8%，接近随机水平。在一项回顾性眼科医生读片研究中，在 CFP 基础上加入合成 FFA 同时提高了下游分类器性能和总体诊断准确率。这些结果支持将合成 FFA 作为筛查高危婴儿的一种潜在有用的无创辅助手段，并有望在真实临床场景中减少对基于染料的检查的依赖。

title: VoxelSlicer: Adaptive Voxel-wise Slicer for Deformable Image Registration.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: VoxelSlicer：用于可变形图像配准的自适应体素切片器
summary: 提出受双边网格启发、带可学习自适应滤波的神经网络模块，改善高形变结构与滑动、呼吸运动下的可变形配准。
key_points: 针对各向同性扩散正则化导致边界过平滑
体素级自适应滤波，处理位移场局部不连续

reason: 有新意的配准方法，摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Recent progress in neural networks has accelerated deformable image registration (DIR) by amortizing iterative optimization, offering faster results and potential accuracy gains with label supervision. However, existing methods struggle with highly deformed structures (e.g., inter-subject abdominal or intra-subject cardiac scans) and fail to handle complex motions like sliding or respiratory dynamics. This limitation arises from isotropic diffusive pair-wise regularization, which leads to inefficient message passing and oversmoothed boundaries. We propose VoxelSlicer, a novel neural network module inspired by the traditional bilateral grid but enhanced with learnable adaptive filtering. VoxelSlicer enables voxel-wise adaptive filtering, addressing local discontinuities in displacement fields and performs more efficient message passing. This design enables adaptive displacement-cost propagation with a compact parameter footprint and a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. Experiments on four realistic datasets and two synthetic datasets with different modalities and input constraints demonstrate VoxelSlicer's competitive registration performance together with favorable accuracy-complexity and accuracy-smoothness trade-offs.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 神经网络的最新进展通过摊销迭代优化加速了可变形图像配准（DIR），在有标签监督时可提供更快的结果并可能提高精度。然而，现有方法难以处理高度形变的结构（如受试者间腹部扫描或受试者内心脏扫描），也无法处理滑动或呼吸动力学等复杂运动。这一局限源于各向同性的扩散式成对正则化，导致信息传递效率低下和边界过度平滑。我们提出了 VoxelSlicer，这是一种新型神经网络模块，其灵感来自传统的双边网格（bilateral grid），并通过可学习的自适应滤波加以增强。VoxelSlicer 可实现逐体素的自适应滤波，解决位移场中的局部不连续问题，并实现更高效的信息传递。该设计能够以紧凑的参数量实现自适应的位移代价传播，并在精度与复杂度之间取得良好的权衡。在四个真实数据集和两个合成数据集（具有不同模态和输入约束）上的实验表明，VoxelSlicer 具有有竞争力的配准性能，并在精度-复杂度和精度-平滑度之间取得了良好的权衡。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) scribe systems (AAS) across multiple domains using a rapid learning health system (LHS) approach, including provider satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability, and patient sentiment. This LHS evaluation compared 2 AAS systems (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days. Evaluation incorporated a cluster randomized crossover comparison, analysis of use and EHR-based workflow outcomes, and standardized simulated encounters to assess documentation quality and safety. Outcomes included provider satisfaction, efficiency, note quality, usability, and patient sentiment. In standardized simulated encounters, both systems achieved 76% note element accuracy with minimal risk for harm. In the randomized crossover comparison, Abridge demonstrated higher usability scores (78.5 vs 73) and was preferred 3:1 over Nabla, which had higher automated speech recognition error rates. Across 16 479 clinical encounters, AAS was used in 35.7% of visits. Total EHR time decreased by approximately 5 minutes per day; same-day chart closure increased by approximately 5% during the initial crossover period, but this effect was attenuated. Provider experience was positive (Net Promoter Score [NPS] 53). Both systems demonstrated comparable documentation accuracy and modest efficiency gains while improving clinician satisfaction. Despite similar performance, clinicians reported differences in usability and preference. Adoption below 40% reflected the trade-off between documentation support and verification burden. Rapid, multidimensional evaluation within a LHS can assess AAS across domains of implementation, efficiency, clinician experience, and documentation quality and safety. Ongoing monitoring of efficiency, documentation quality, and use patterns is essential.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 采用快速学习型健康系统（LHS）方法，从提供者满意度、效率、文书质量、可用性和患者态度等多个维度评估环境式人工智能（AI）记录系统（AAS）。本次 LHS 评估在 100 名提供者中比较了 2 种 AAS 系统（Abridge 和 Nabla），为期 90 天。评估包括整群随机交叉比较、使用情况及基于电子健康记录（EHR）的工作流程结局分析，以及用于评估文书质量和安全性的标准化模拟就诊。结局包括提供者满意度、效率、病历记录质量、可用性和患者态度。在标准化模拟就诊中，两个系统的病历要素准确率均为 76%，且造成伤害的风险极小。在随机交叉比较中，Abridge 的可用性得分更高（78.5 比 73），并以 3:1 的比例优于 Nabla，而 Nabla 的自动语音识别错误率更高。在 16 479 次临床就诊中，35.7% 的就诊使用了 AAS。EHR 总用时每天减少约 5 分钟；在最初的交叉期内，当日病历关闭率增加约 5%，但该效应随后减弱。提供者体验为正面（净推荐值 [NPS] 53）。两个系统的文书准确性相当，效率有适度提升，同时提高了临床医生满意度。尽管性能相近，临床医生报告在可用性和偏好方面存在差异。低于 40% 的采用率反映了文书支持与核查负担之间的权衡。在 LHS 内进行快速、多维度的评估，可以从实施、效率、临床医生体验以及文书质量和安全性等方面评估 AAS。对效率、文书质量和使用模式进行持续监测至关重要。

abstract: Abnormal body composition at intensive care unit (ICU) admission is associated with worse survival, but it is rarely measured in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive. We conducted a secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 patients who underwent chest CT within 24 h of ICU admission, of whom 475 were included in the final analysis. Open-source AI segmentation was used to quantify body composition, and the resulting features were related to 6-month survival. Risk scores derived from body composition were significantly associated with 6-month survival (p < 0.001, log-rank test). In five-fold cross-validation, the AUC for discriminating survivors from non-survivors was 0.73; when feature selection was accounted for, the AUC was 0.68 by nested cross-validation and 0.69 by bootstrap optimism correction. The study shows that the automated AI-based analysis of admission chest CT yields body composition scores significantly associated with 6-month mortality after ICU admission.

abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Automated identification and extraction of recommendations for additional imaging (RAI) from radiology reports could facilitate closed-loop tracking and follow-up completion. We compare a prompt-engineered GPT-4.1 large language model (LLM) versus a validated encoder-only transformer deep learning model (bidirectional encoder representations from transformers [BERT]) for detection of RAI in abdominopelvic computed tomography (CTAP) reports, and evaluate GPT-4.1 for extraction of actionable RAI elements. This retrospective study included CTAP reports from a multi-institution system in 2023. LLM and BERT were used to identify RAI from radiology reports; LLM also extracted RAI actionable elements (modality, body part, time frame, rationale). Recall, precision, F1, and accuracy for RAI detection were determined using human-annotated reference standard. Paired comparison between each model's accuracy used McNemar's test. LLM recall, precision, F1, and accuracy for actionable element extraction were computed. Element prevalence was compared using chi-square test. 2000 random reports for unique patients (58% women; mean age 58.5 ± 17.5) included 215 RAI within 206 reports. For RAI detection, GPT-4.1 recall, precision, F1 and accuracy were 95.6%, 98.5%, 97.0% and 99.4%, respectively; BERT recall, precision, F1 and accuracy were 93.7%, 96.5%, 95.1% and 99.0% (p = 0.16). Recommendation element recall were as follows: 100.0% for time frame, 93.9% for body part, 90.2% for rationale, and 94.2% for modality. Precision were 100.0%, 95.7%, 94.6% and 86.1%, respectively. 29/215 (13.5%) RAI were complete (specified all actionable elements). Prevalence of actionable elements varied (p < 0.001), highest for rationale (215/215, 100%), followed by body part (213/215, 99.1%), modality (191/215, 88.8%), and time frame (31/215, 14.4%). GPT-4.1 demonstrated high accuracy for extraction of RAI and enabled accurate extraction of actionable elements. LLM integration into radiology workflows can facilitate automatic closed-loop communication and tracking of recommended imaging, which may reduce diagnostic delays.

abstract: [Journal of medical imaging (Bellingham, Wash.)] Deep learning image reconstruction or restoration can produce visually high-quality images that may lack familiar visual cues of reliability. Diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) is a stochastic reconstruction algorithm capable of producing samples from the posterior distribution, offering a potential mechanism to communicate uncertainty and a representation of the posterior distribution to radiologists. We designed and conducted an observer study to evaluate whether displaying multiple DPS posterior samples improves task-based performance in human readers compared with displaying a single DPS sample. The observer study evaluated performance for a binary discrimination task involving spiculated and non-spiculated lung lesions. A total of 200 lung lesions were obtained from the Lung Image Database Consortium dataset, including 100 spiculated and 100 non-spiculated lesions. Computed tomography slices containing these lesions were treated as ground truth. Low-dose projection data were simulated and reconstructed using filtered backprojection and DPS. Six radiologists evaluated each case under four display conditions: low-dose filtered backprojection, a single DPS sample, a scrollable stack of 30 DPS samples, and a tiled display of the same 30 DPS samples. Observer performance was assessed using multi-reader multi-case receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, with Lung Image Database Consortium spiculation annotations used as ground truth. Reading time and reader confidence were also recorded. Pooled area under the ROC curves (AUCs) were 0.691 for low-dose filtered-backprojection (FBP), 0.713 for single-sample DPS, 0.750 for the scrollable stack, and 0.747 for the tiled display. Both multi-sample DPS displays improved pooled AUC relative to single-sample DPS at the 10% significance level. The better-performing multi-sample display was reader-dependent. Multi-sample displays were also associated with higher reader confidence than single-sample DPS and FBP displays. Multi-sample displays generally increased reading time, although there was a wide reader-dependent variability in reading time and in which multi-sample display was most time consuming. Averaged over all readers, the scrollable stack and tiled displays increased average reading time by 34.6% and 55.8% relative to low-dose FBP, respectively. Results from the study provide initial evidence that radiologists can use information from multiple posterior samples to improve task-based imaging perform

abstract: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

abstract: A protein can engage multiple partners, making it challenging to disrupt disease-associated interactions while preserving others. We developed Bivexia, an AI agent that guides a multistage pipeline from discovery and de novo design through preclinical evaluation. Its decision rules are fixed in advance, and each prospective selection by the agent is cryptographically committed before testing. The objective is to discover small molecules that disrupt specified interactions of a target protein while preserving others. A compound advanced by Bivexia bound LAG-3 with nanomolar affinity and disrupted its interactions with tau and amyloid-{beta} while preserving binding to MHC class II and FGL1. It reduced tau and amyloid-{beta} burden in independent cohorts across two mouse models. The same rules gave three of nine hits on PrP and two of nine on LRP1, none in random controls. Our findings establish a framework for AI agents to pursue defined interaction selectivity across targets.

abstract: [Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education] Patients and caregivers increasingly consult large language model (LLM) chatbots for glioma-related information. Explaining glioma requires discussion of tumor classification, molecular pathology, treatment, and prognosis, making accurate patient education challenging. However, the quality of glioma-related information generated by LLMs has not been systematically evaluated. To compare the quality, transparency, and readability of glioma-related information generated by four publicly accessible LLM chatbots and assess whether their responses meet recommended readability standards for patient education. In this cross-sectional study, Google Trends was used to identify commonly searched glioma-related topics. Seventeen patient-oriented questions derived from 19 search terms were submitted to ChatGPT 5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Microsoft Copilot, and Perplexity. Two independent reviewers assessed response quality using DISCERN, Ensuring Quality Information for Patients (EQIP), the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) benchmark criteria, and the Global Quality Score (GQS). Readability was evaluated using six validated indices. Group differences were analyzed with the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn-Bonferroni post hoc comparisons. Significant differences were observed among the four chatbots for DISCERN (P = 0.001), EQIP (P < 0.001), JAMA (P < 0.001), and GQS (P = 0.022). Copilot achieved the highest DISCERN and EQIP scores, whereas ChatGPT received the highest GQS. Copilot and Perplexity demonstrated better transparency than ChatGPT and Gemini, although overall transparency remained limited. None of the chatbots met recommended readability standards for patient education. Publicly accessible LLM chatbots can provide structured glioma-related information, but performance varies across platforms. Limited transparency and poor readability restrict their suitability as stand-alone patient education tools. Improvements in evidence attribution, guideline-based retrieval, uncertainty communication, and plain-language adaptation are needed before routine use in neuro-oncology.

abstract: [Anatolian journal of cardiology] Accurate non-invasive localization of premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) is important for preprocedural planning before catheter ablation. Most artificial intelligence-based electrocardiography (ECG) models evaluate ectopic beats without incorporating patient-specific baseline ventricular conduction patterns. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a patient-referenced, QRS-centered deep learning framework integrating paired sinus rhythm and PVC 12-lead ECG recordings for binary localization of ventricular ectopic origin and to assess the incremental value of sinus rhythm information compared with PVC-only input. This retrospective, single-center diagnostic accuracy study included 270 patients with paired sinus rhythm and PVC ECG recordings and procedurally confirmed ventricular ectopic origin. Raw ECG signals were segmented using annotated QRS boundaries and aligned using a QRS-centered strategy. Three input strategies were evaluated: paired PVC + sinus rhythm, PVC-only, and sinus rhythm-only. A 1-dimensional residual convolutional neural network (CNN) (1D ResNet) and a 2-dimensional time-domain CNN (2D time-domain CNN) were trained directly on raw ECG waveforms, with late-fusion probability averaging used for ensemble predictions. Performance was assessed using 5-fold patient-level cross-validation. The primary endpoint was the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). For paired PVC + sinus rhythm input, pooled AUROC values were 0.753 for the 1D ResNet, 0.743 for the 2D time-domain CNN, and 0.762 for the late-fusion ensemble, with no statistically significant differences among architectures. In the cross-input comparison, ensemble AUROC was 0.762 for paired PVC + sinus rhythm, 0.731 for PVC-only, and 0.551 for sinus rhythm-only input. Paired PVC + sinus rhythm significantly outperformed PVC-only input (DeLong P = .0313), whereas sinus rhythm alone showed limited discrimination. Patient-specific sinus rhythm information provided incremental discriminatory value when combined with PVC morphology for binary left ventricular-right ventricular (LV-RV) localization, while sinus rhythm alone had limited discriminatory value. These findings provide proof-of-concept evidence supporting paired sinus rhythm-PVC modeling as a physiologically informed approach to ventricular ectopic localization. External validation and comparison with established ECG-based localization criteria are required before clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [Anatolian journal of cardiology] 准确的无创室性早搏（PVC）定位对导管消融术前规划非常重要。大多数基于人工智能的心电图（ECG）模型在评估异位搏动时并未纳入患者特异性的基线心室传导模式。本研究旨在开发并评估一种以患者自身为参照、以 QRS 为中心的深度学习框架，该框架整合配对的窦性心律与 PVC 12 导联 ECG 记录，用于心室异位起源的二分类定位，并评估与仅使用 PVC 输入相比，窦性心律信息的增量价值。这项回顾性、单中心诊断准确性研究纳入了 270 例具有配对窦性心律和 PVC ECG 记录且心室异位起源经操作证实的患者。原始 ECG 信号根据标注的 QRS 边界进行分段，并采用以 QRS 为中心的策略对齐。评估了三种输入策略：配对 PVC + 窦性心律、仅 PVC、仅窦性心律。一维残差卷积神经网络（CNN）（1D ResNet）和二维时域 CNN（2D time-domain CNN）直接在原始 ECG 波形上训练，并采用后期融合概率平均进行集成预测。性能通过 5 折患者水平交叉验证进行评估。主要终点为受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。对于配对 PVC + 窦性心律输入，1D ResNet 的汇总 AUROC 为 0.753，2D time-domain CNN 为 0.743，后期融合集成为 0.762，各架构之间差异无统计学意义。在不同输入的比较中，集成模型的 AUROC 在配对 PVC + 窦性心律为 0.762，仅 PVC 为 0.731，仅窦性心律为 0.551。配对 PVC + 窦性心律显著优于仅 PVC 输入（DeLong P = .0313），而仅窦性心律的区分能力有限。在左心室-右心室（LV-RV）二分类定位中，患者特异性窦性心律信息与 PVC 形态结合时提供了增量的区分价值，而单独使用窦性心律的区分价值有限。这些发现为配对窦性心律-PVC 建模作为一种符合生理学的心室异位定位方法提供了概念验证证据。在临床应用之前，需要进行外部验证并与已确立的基于 ECG 的定位标准进行比较。

abstract: [Otolaryngology--head and neck surgery : official journal of American Academy of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery] To compare the quality of patient-facing thyroid cancer information generated by clinicians, large language models (LLMs), and web search results using parallel expert and layperson evaluation under blinded conditions. Blinded comparative evaluation study. Online, text-based assessment of patient-facing health information. Thirty commonly searched thyroid cancer questions were identified using Google Trends. For each question, patient-facing answers were generated by a fellowship-trained head and neck surgeon, 5 widely used LLMs (GPT-4, GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek), and the first nonsponsored Google search result. Responses were anonymised and source-blinded. Seven attending physicians evaluated responses using the Quality Analysis of Medical AI (QAMAI) framework across 5 domains, and 15 lay participants evaluated the same responses across 4 patient-centred domains. Ratings were analysed at the question level using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC), Friedman tests, Kendall's W, and post-hoc Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Expert inter-rater reliability was good across domains (ICC 0.78-0.82). Expert ratings differed significantly across sources (P < .001; Kendall's W = 0.70-0.81), with Claude achieving the highest expert scores and Google-derived responses the lowest. Layperson ratings also differed significantly (P < .001; Kendall's W = 0.70-0.87) but clustered near the upper end of the scale, indicating a ceiling effect. The largest expert-rated differences occurred for treatment-related questions, particularly radioactive iodine therapy. Patient-facing thyroid cancer information quality varies across clinicians, LLMs, and web search results. Divergence between expert and layperson assessments indicates that perceived clarity and reassurance do not reliably reflect expert-defined completeness or clinical robustness.

abstract: [FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology] Preeclampsia (PE) is a heterogeneous pregnancy disorder characterized by placental dysfunction and immune dysregulation. Translation of transcriptomic biomarkers has been limited by inconsistent feature selection, inadequate external validation, and poor model interpretability. We developed an explainable, externally validated, transcriptomics-driven artificial intelligence framework for biomarker discovery, PE diagnosis, and exploratory severity stratification. Placental transcriptomic datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus. Differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis were integrated with consensus feature selection using Elastic Net, LASSO, SVM-RFE, and Boruta. Selected biomarkers were evaluated using conventional machine learning, deep learning, ensemble, and hybrid models with repeated stratified cross-validation and independent cross-platform external validation. Model performance and interpretability were assessed using ROC and precision-recall analyses, DeLong's test, permutation testing, SHAP, and permutation importance. Integrative analyses identified 166 candidate genes and prioritized a six-gene signature comprising CGB5, LEP, LIMCH1, LRRC1, PAPPA2, and SIGLEC6. Logistic Regression achieved the highest external performance (ROC-AUC: 0.8516, 95% CI: 0.7913-0.9119; PR-AUC: 0.8572). DeLong's test showed no significant differences from the best-performing deep or hybrid models. Explainability analyses consistently identified LEP, LRRC1, PAPPA2, and SIGLEC6 as major predictive contributors. Exploratory early versus late-onset PE stratification achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.7617. The proposed framework identified a reproducible six-gene placental signature with robust cross-platform predictive performance and biological interpretability. Integrating consensus biomarker selection, external validation, and explainable artificial intelligence may facilitate the reproducible development of transcriptomic biomarkers for precision medicine in PE.
zh_abstract: [FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology] 子痫前期（PE）是一种以胎盘功能障碍和免疫失调为特征的异质性妊娠疾病。转录组生物标志物的转化应用一直受限于特征选择不一致、外部验证不足以及模型可解释性差。我们开发了一个可解释、经外部验证、由转录组驱动的人工智能框架，用于生物标志物发现、PE诊断以及探索性的严重程度分层。胎盘转录组数据集来自 Gene Expression Omnibus。将差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析与采用 Elastic Net、LASSO、SVM-RFE 和 Boruta 的共识特征选择相整合。所选生物标志物采用传统机器学习、深度学习、集成及混合模型进行评估，并采用重复分层交叉验证和独立的跨平台外部验证。模型性能和可解释性通过 ROC 和精确率-召回率分析、DeLong 检验、置换检验、SHAP 以及置换重要性进行评估。整合分析鉴定出 166 个候选基因，并优选出由 CGB5、LEP、LIMCH1、LRRC1、PAPPA2 和 SIGLEC6 组成的六基因特征。逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）取得了最高的外部验证性能（ROC-AUC：0.8516，95% CI：0.7913–0.9119；PR-AUC：0.8572）。DeLong 检验显示其与表现最佳的深度学习或混合模型之间无显著差异。可解释性分析一致认为 LEP、LRRC1、PAPPA2 和 SIGLEC6 是主要的预测贡献因子。早发型与晚发型 PE 的探索性分层取得了 0.7617 的 ROC-AUC。所提出的框架鉴定出一个可重复的六基因胎盘特征，具有稳健的跨平台预测性能和生物学可解释性。将共识生物标志物选择、外部验证和可解释人工智能相结合，可能有助于推动 PE 精准医学中转录组生物标志物的可重复开发。

abstract: [Polski merkuriusz lekarski : organ Polskiego Towarzystwa Lekarskiego] Aim: To examine whether clinician authorization is an effective and sufficient safeguard when artificial intelligence influences treatment choices or drug prescribing. Materials and Methods: Purposively selected English-language empirical studies (January 2021 to August 2026; PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, SSRN, and ResearchGate, supplemented by reference lists) were synthesized descriptively alongside a comparative analysis of European Union and United States legislation and guidance. The review does not claim systematic coverage. Generative artificial intelligence was used only to assist source identification and revision. Conclusions: The proposed Meaningful Human Clinical Control test assesses reviewability, competence, time, authority, independent clinical justification, and traceability. These normative domains have no validated scoring method; their purpose is to identify remediable restrictions on clinical review. Liability still depends on the rules on defect, fault, and causation. A signature shows who authorized a prescription, not what that authorization involved.

abstract: [Reproductive sciences (Thousand Oaks, Calif.)] Can an AI-driven clinical decision support system reliably support clinical decision making across all steps of assisted reproductive technology (ART) work-up?. This study evaluates Fertility Oriented Expert (FOX), an AI-driven system designed for all steps of ART. FOX incorporates 3,998 full-text, open-access reproductive medicine publications (January 2000 - September 2025) with commercial large language models (LLMs) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Thirty-two clinical questions covering ART pathway were used to evaluate the system. Responses generated by different FOX models were compared. Three common clinical cases with key diagnostic clues were presented to the FOX-GPT-5 to analyze further if the system could identify these clues and recommend a management plan. Finally, the responses generated by traditional GPT models were compared with the ones generated by FOX. Performance was assessed using G-score and semantic score, with statistical comparison via the Friedman rank-sum. Median G-scores showed no statistically significant differences between the models (0.8 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.8 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.95 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.21). Median semantic scores were also similar (0.89 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.89 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.9 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.56. For clinical cases, FOX recommended appropriate treatment options, achieving high G-scores and semantic scores (G-score: 1-1; semantic score: 0.88-0.93). GPT models achieved high G-scores and semantic scores based on FOX model answers (G-score: 0.8-1; semantic score: 0.75-0.99) without statistically significant differences between the different GPT models (G-score P = 0.36; semantic score P = 0.65). FOX provides evidence-based information, covering ART pathway, providing clinical decision-making support for fertility specialists.
zh_abstract: [Reproductive sciences (Thousand Oaks, Calif.)] 人工智能驱动的临床决策支持系统能否在辅助生殖技术（ART）诊疗的各个环节可靠地支持临床决策？本研究评估了 Fertility Oriented Expert（FOX），这是一个面向 ART 全部环节设计的人工智能驱动系统。FOX 采用检索增强生成（RAG），将 3,998 篇全文开放获取的生殖医学文献（2000年1月至2025年9月）与商用大语言模型（LLM）相结合。研究使用覆盖 ART 全流程的 32 个临床问题对该系统进行评估，并比较了不同 FOX 模型生成的回答。向 FOX-GPT-5 提供三个带有关键诊断线索的常见临床病例，以进一步分析该系统能否识别这些线索并推荐处理方案。最后，将传统 GPT 模型生成的回答与 FOX 生成的回答进行比较。采用 G-score 和语义评分（semantic score）评估性能，并通过 Friedman 秩和检验进行统计学比较。各模型的 G-score 中位数差异无统计学意义（FOX-GPT-5 为 0.8，FOX-GPT-4o 为 0.8，FOX-GPT-o1 为 0.95；P = 0.21）。语义评分中位数也相近（FOX-GPT-5 为 0.89，FOX-GPT-4o 为 0.89，FOX-GPT-o1 为 0.9；P = 0.56）。对于临床病例，FOX 推荐了恰当的治疗方案，G-score 和语义评分均较高（G-score：1-1；语义评分：0.88-0.93）。以 FOX 模型的回答为基准，GPT 模型获得了较高的 G-score 和语义评分（G-score：0.8-1；语义评分：0.75-0.99），不同 GPT 模型之间差异无统计学意义（G-score P = 0.36；语义评分 P = 0.65）。FOX 可提供涵盖 ART 全流程的循证信息，为生殖专科医师提供临床决策支持。

abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] Background Effective communication in the ICU is essential, yet timely access to professional interpreters remains challenging for patients with non-English language preference. Language discordance in high-acuity settings has been associated with miscommunication, delays in care, and adverse outcomes. Speech-based artificial intelligence (AI) interpretation tools have emerged as potential adjuncts to bridge communication gaps, but comparative usability data in high-stakes clinical settings remain limited. Objective To evaluate and compare clinician-reported usability of three speech-based AI interpretation tools during physician-led simulated ICU family meetings. Methods We conducted a comparative study involving 21 ICU physicians. Each participant completed three simulated ICU family meetings representing high-stakes scenarios including ECMO discussion, tracheotomy planning, and transition to comfort care. Participants were assigned to one non-English language (Spanish, Chinese, or Arabic) and used three speech-based interpretation tools (AI-TransLATE, ChatGPT, and Gemini) in counterbalanced order. After each encounter, clinicians completed the System Usability Scale (SUS) and structured Likert-scale assessments of satisfaction, perceived communication effectiveness, effort, and acceptability. Results AI-TransLATE achieved a median SUS of 70.0 (IQR 64.4-75.6) and ChatGPT 72.5 (IQR 70.0- 75.0), both meeting the acceptable threshold (≥70). Gemini received 40.0 (IQR 25.0-57.5), falling below the acceptable range. Gemini differed significantly from both AI-TransLATE and ChatGPT, while AI-TransLATE and ChatGPT did not differ significantly. Satisfaction, perceived communication effectiveness, and willingness to use in clinical practice were also significantly higher for AI-TransLATE and ChatGPT compared with Gemini. Conclusion In simulated ICU family meetings, select speech-based AI interpretation tools demonstrated acceptable clinician-reported usability, supporting further investigation of their potential as complementary interpretation tools when professional interpreter access is limited. Future work should prioritize validation and evaluation of patient understanding in real-world settings , to support safe and scalable implementation.

abstract: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.
zh_abstract: 离线治疗学习必须在模仿与价值最大化之间取得平衡：模仿贴近已记录的证据但忽略结局，价值最大化利用结局但会偏向记录无法验证的治疗。数值型强化学习在训练期间实现这种平衡。对于大语言模型（LLM），直接利用稀疏的回顾性结局进行微调，会带来延迟信用分配以及替代治疗证据有限的挑战。我们提出 R-LLMC，它在推理阶段为脓毒症复苏实现这种平衡。一个经行为监督的 LLM 被解码为对 25 种升压药-液体动作的精确分布，提出以临床医生行为为锚点的候选方案；离线评价器（critic）依据估计的长期价值在其中进行选择。该策略具有用于离策略评估的闭式形式，其理由说明在选择之后生成，因此解释不会左右治疗。在保留的 MIMIC-III 患者实验中，R-LLMC 的双重稳健价值比临床医生参考高 +0.214（95% CI 0.091–0.300），拟合 Q 评估结果与之一致。

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly reshaping genitourinary (GU) medical oncology across the cancer-care continuum. In this structured narrative review, we apply the ten-hallmark precision-oncology taxonomy proposed by Chang et al. to GU malignancies. We further define GU-specific hallmark boundaries and introduce study-design and validation descriptors that span proof-of-concept, internal and external validation, prospective clinical evaluation, and prospective interventional evaluation, while distinguishing evidence derived from randomized trials. Across prostate, urothelial, and kidney cancers, AI has shown promising technical performance in imaging, pathology, molecular inference, and outcome modeling. General-oncology trial-matching benchmarks offer additional research opportunities, although evidence remains uneven. Among the examples reviewed, validation designs highly vary, and strong discrimination should not be interpreted as evidence of clinical benefit. We therefore emphasize cohort size, validation design, head-to-head comparator evidence, calibration when reported, and implementation considerations including regulation, model drift, fairness, clinician oversight, cybersecurity, workflow integration, and cost. The next phase of AI in GU oncology will depend on demonstrating incremental clinical utility and patient benefit, not only higher accuracy.
zh_abstract: [肿瘤学前沿（Frontiers in oncology）] 人工智能（AI）正日益重塑贯穿肿瘤诊疗全程的泌尿生殖系统（GU）肿瘤内科学。在这篇结构化叙述性综述中，我们将 Chang 等人提出的十大特征（hallmark）精准肿瘤学分类法应用于 GU 恶性肿瘤。我们进一步界定了 GU 特异性的特征边界，并引入了研究设计与验证描述指标，涵盖概念验证、内部和外部验证、前瞻性临床评估及前瞻性干预性评估，同时区分来自随机试验的证据。在前列腺癌、尿路上皮癌和肾癌中，AI 在影像、病理、分子推断和结局建模方面已显示出有前景的技术性能。一般肿瘤学的试验匹配基准提供了额外的研究机会，但证据仍不均衡。在所综述的实例中，验证设计差异很大，高区分度不应被解读为临床获益的证据。因此，我们强调队列规模、验证设计、头对头对照证据、（如有报告的）校准，以及包括监管、模型漂移、公平性、临床医生监督、网络安全、工作流程整合和成本在内的实施考量。GU 肿瘤学中 AI 的下一阶段将取决于证明其增量临床效用和患者获益，而不仅仅是更高的准确性。

abstract: Inferring gene regulation from single-cell data is difficult because observational measurements cannot distinguish correlation from causation and access to perturbational data, especially with multiple modalities, remains limited. Here we present the Cross-Modal Causal Variational Autoencoder (CMC-VAE), which learns a network linking genes and proteins (gene-gene, protein-protein and gene-protein) in the latent space and maps each connection back onto measured features. Trained on 809,130 observational CITE-seq profiles, CMC-VAE recovers co-expression, transcription factor regulons and immune signalling programs, and learns a sparse cross-modal map enriched for transcript-protein cognate pairs. On three CRISPR screens used during development, it ranks knockout-responsive genes better than correlation and latent-VAE baselines. Fitted to a screen's unperturbed control cells, without perturbation labels, the model translates measured knockout RNA responses into protein responses better than a correlation map and cognate transcripts. The direction of gene-to-gene regulation, however, is not recovered from observational data. On the CITE-seq screens, fine-tuning only the latent network improves held-out response correlation, mainly by learning a response shared across knockouts. On larger Perturb-seq screens, with about 1,000 training perturbations, fine-tuning the latent network learns gene-specific effects that transfer to held-out genes, more so than a gene-level causal model fine-tuned on the same cells, and in simulation, such interventions also restore edge orientations that observational training leaves unresolved.
zh_abstract: 从单细胞数据推断基因调控十分困难，因为观察性测量无法区分相关与因果，而扰动数据（尤其是多模态扰动数据）的获取仍然有限。在此我们提出跨模态因果变分自编码器（CMC-VAE），它在潜空间中学习连接基因与蛋白质（基因-基因、蛋白质-蛋白质和基因-蛋白质）的网络，并将每个连接映射回所测量的特征。CMC-VAE 在 809,130 个观察性 CITE-seq 谱上训练，可还原共表达、转录因子调控子和免疫信号程序，并学习到富集转录本-蛋白质对应配对的稀疏跨模态图谱。在开发过程中使用的三个 CRISPR 筛选上，它对敲除响应基因的排序优于相关性和潜空间 VAE 基线。当模型拟合于某个筛选中未扰动的对照细胞（无扰动标签）时，其将所测得的敲除 RNA 响应转化为蛋白质响应的表现优于相关性图谱和对应转录本。然而，基因到基因调控的方向无法从观察性数据中还原。在 CITE-seq 筛选上，仅微调潜网络可提高留出数据的响应相关性，主要是通过学习各敲除间共有的响应。在更大的 Perturb-seq 筛选上（约 1,000 个训练扰动），微调潜网络可学习到能迁移至留出基因的基因特异性效应，其效果优于在相同细胞上微调的基因水平因果模型；在模拟中，此类干预也能恢复观察性训练所未能解决的边方向。

abstract: The human methylome is poorly understood and, as such, the vast majority of epigenetic aging clocks are unexplainable black boxes. To address this, we created CheekAI, a robust deep learning model that uses lifestyle and health epigenetic biomarker proxies (EBPs) to predict age. Trained using a longitudinal dataset of 25,400 adult buccal DNA methylation samples derived from 14,716 distinct adults, we used principal components and multi-objective optimization to produce a clock that is explainable, reproducible, responsive, and accurate. The Pearson correlation with chronological age is 0.969, the mean absolute error is 2.49 years, and the intraclass correlation coefficient across 679 replicate pairs is 0.990. CheekAI was significantly associated with a plethora of lifestyle and health variables, including resting heart rate, omega-3 intake, ultra-processed food intake, daily step count, resistance training, and time spent in nature. When applied to external saliva and buccal datasets, CheekAI significantly captured a variety of signals, including smoking and oesophageal cancer. CheekAI was also significantly reduced by a multifactorial lifestyle intervention and this reduction was driven by improvements in dietary and metabolic EBPs. This novel artificial intelligence model represents the first instance of a buccal epigenetic aging clock that utilizes EBPs to offer interpretability and actionability.
zh_abstract: 人类甲基化组目前仍所知甚少，因此绝大多数表观遗传衰老时钟都是无法解释的“黑箱”。为解决这一问题，我们构建了 CheekAI，这是一种稳健的深度学习模型，利用生活方式和健康相关的表观遗传生物标志物代理指标（epigenetic biomarker proxies，EBPs）来预测年龄。我们使用来自 14,716 名不同成年人的 25,400 份成人颊黏膜 DNA 甲基化样本组成的纵向数据集进行训练，并采用主成分分析和多目标优化，得到了一个可解释、可重复、有响应性且准确的时钟。其与实际年龄的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.969，平均绝对误差为 2.49 岁，679 对重复样本的组内相关系数为 0.990。CheekAI 与大量生活方式和健康变量显著相关，包括静息心率、omega-3 摄入量、超加工食品摄入量、每日步数、抗阻训练以及在自然环境中度过的时间。应用于外部唾液和颊黏膜数据集时，CheekAI 显著捕捉到多种信号，包括吸烟和食管癌。多因素生活方式干预也使 CheekAI 显著降低，且这一降低由饮食和代谢相关 EBPs 的改善所驱动。这一新型人工智能模型是首个利用 EBPs 提供可解释性和可操作性的颊黏膜表观遗传衰老时钟。

abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] The physical exam remains a fundamental part of the clinical encounter, but physical exam skills have declined over the last several decades. This decline contributes to diagnostic error, overutilization of diagnostic testing, rising healthcare costs, an erosion of public trust, decreased empathy, and physician burnout. As clinicians increasingly turn to generative artificial intelligence to help with cognitive tasks, the information that we gather at the bedside through a history and physical exam has never been more important. Beyond diagnosis, the physical exam builds connection, conveys caring, and helps physicians and patients navigate uncertainty. We need to re-examine the importance of the physical exam in a tech-enabled clinical environment, design low-touch assessments to better evaluate and teach physical exam skills, integrate emerging technology into the modern physical exam, and embrace the power of the physical exam beyond its diagnostic potential. This commentary highlights these issues and suggests several strategies to begin the revitalization of the physical exam.
zh_abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] 体格检查仍是临床接诊的基本组成部分，但在过去数十年中，体格检查技能有所下降。这种下降导致诊断错误、诊断检测过度使用、医疗费用上升、公众信任受损、同理心下降以及医生职业倦怠。随着临床医生越来越多地借助生成式人工智能来完成认知任务，我们通过病史采集和体格检查在床旁收集的信息变得前所未有地重要。除诊断之外，体格检查还能建立联系、传达关怀，并帮助医生和患者应对不确定性。我们需要重新审视体格检查在技术赋能的临床环境中的重要性，设计低接触式评估以更好地评价和教授体格检查技能，将新兴技术融入现代体格检查，并充分发挥体格检查在诊断潜力之外的作用。本评论强调了这些问题，并提出若干策略以开启体格检查的振兴。

abstract: [Polski merkuriusz lekarski : organ Polskiego Towarzystwa Lekarskiego] Aim: To assess the compatibility of the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act with the right to healthcare via the Ukrainian concept of vital security. Materials and Methods: The study was conducted in 2026 and analyzed 29 legal, policy, and academic sources, as well as European Union and Ukrainian legal and policy documents relevant to artificial intelligence in healthcare, fundamental rights, and patient protection. The study applied comparative legal, formal-dogmatic, and systemic-structural methods. Artificial intelligence tools supported information search and proofreading; Grammarly was used for language editing. Conclusions: The European Union Artificial Intelligence Act's market-based risk model contradicts the absolute, "optimizing" approach of a Beveridge healthcare model like Ukraine. abstract: [International nursing review] To clarify cognitive health and dementia care as nursing well-being policy and identify policy levers through which prevention, coordinated care, data linkage and governed artificial intelligence may reduce avoidable nursing burden. Cognitive impairment, dementia and delirium shape nursing work through behavioural crises, fragmented information, repeated documentation, family distress, safety risks and moral strain. Although often treated as clinical or ageing-policy issues, these pressures affect workload, violence exposure, retention and well-being. Japan provides an illustrative context where ageing, dementia reform, community-based care and digital health converge. This non-empirical policy analysis was informed by a targeted narrative evidence synthesis. Searches of nursing and health literature published from January 2014 to May 2026 were supplemented by targeted searches of international and Japanese policy repositories and citation chasing. Sources were prioritised by policy relevance, nursing relevance, evidential strength and applicability. Nursing well-being policy is a focused part of workforce policy addressing workload, safety and moral distress, rather than general employment conditions. Prevention and information continuity may reduce avoidable burden; artificial intelligence remains an adjunct requiring evaluation. Policy levers include education, protected care time, coordination, digital governance and safety culture. Cognitive health and dementia care can support nursing well-being when policies connect prevention, person-centred care, interoperable information and cautious technology governance. Nurses should evaluate cognitive health and dementia initiatives using workload, documentation burden, violence exposure and moral distress. Specify nurse-sensitive measures in dementia-service evaluations, resource prevention and coordination time, and assess documentation and alert burdens when procuring digital tools.

abstract: As incentives to digitize more and more aspects of medical healthcare are gaining traction, additional medical data is becoming available. A major goal is to use this data to gain further insights, support medical staff, and ultimately improve patient care. This demands sophisticated solutions that can handle current and future vast amounts of data, all without disrupting well-established workflows of care takers. Additionally, the solution must fulfill the documentation and risk-management obligations of the Medical Device Regulation (MDR), which governs whether a device may be used in patient care in Europe. In this context, we introduce the AMPEL platform, an open-source solution for creating clinical decision support systems (CDSS) that fulfil the requirements of the MDR. Centered around a message broker (Kafka), it adopts an event-driven, distributed architecture, allowing for scaling and efficient processing of medical data as it gets generated. Relying on platform-specific events to implicitly describe the platform's interfaces makes it both extensible and agnostic to the hospital information system in use. With these events being defined in the Protocol Buffers format, medically evaluated algorithms can be independently implemented in a variety of programming languages and easily linked to the platform, extending its analytic capabilities as desired. The platform features a basic UI and alert functionality that can be used to gain medical staff's attention and present analysis results in a traceable and explainable fashion. We further show in a use case how the platform was used to build LAMPE, a CDSS developed and operated at University of Leipzig Medical Center. It demonstrates how the platform solution can be used in a complex and already established environment, while acknowledging current limitations and outlining planned developments to overcome these.
zh_abstract: 随着医疗健康更多方面数字化的激励措施不断获得推动，越来越多的医疗数据变得可用。一个主要目标是利用这些数据获得进一步的见解、支持医务人员，并最终改善患者照护。这需要能够处理当前及未来海量数据的成熟解决方案，同时不能干扰护理人员既有的成熟工作流程。此外，该解决方案还必须履行《医疗器械法规》（Medical Device Regulation，MDR）规定的文档和风险管理义务，该法规决定了某一器械能否在欧洲用于患者照护。在此背景下，我们介绍 AMPEL 平台，这是一个用于构建符合 MDR 要求的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）的开源解决方案。该平台以消息代理（Kafka）为核心，采用事件驱动的分布式架构，可在医疗数据产生时对其进行扩展和高效处理。平台依靠特定于平台的事件来隐式描述其接口，因而既具可扩展性，又与所使用的医院信息系统无关。这些事件以 Protocol Buffers 格式定义，经过医学评估的算法可以用多种编程语言独立实现，并方便地接入平台，按需扩展其分析能力。该平台具有基本的用户界面和警报功能，可用于引起医务人员的注意，并以可追溯、可解释的方式呈现分析结果。我们还通过一个用例展示了如何利用该平台构建 LAMPE，这是在莱比锡大学医学中心开发并运行的 CDSS。该用例展示了平台解决方案如何在复杂且已成熟的环境中使用，同时承认当前的局限，并概述了为克服这些局限而计划进行的开发。

abstract: Background: Glycans orchestrate diverse biological processes, yet they remain underrepresented in computational biology compared to proteins and nucleic acids. Although WURCS 2.0 provides a machine-readable structural representation that preserves uncertainty, the evaluated IUPAC-based deterministic workflow processes 43.1% of the GlyCosmos-derived cohort examined here, motivating approaches that retain structural ambiguity. Methods: To overcome this limitation, GlycanPUG (Probabilistic Uncertainty-aware Graph) was introduced as a pretrained graph model for glycan representation learning. By leveraging WURCS 2.0, GlycanPUG represents candidate linkages and substituent attachments using weighted edges and uncertainty attributes within a heterogeneous graph framework. A 4-layer Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network with a dedicated node pre-enhancement module aggregates edge features weighted by the assigned edge weights, enabling representation of supported structurally ambiguous glycans without selecting a single resolved structure. The model is pretrained on a preprocessed subset of the GlyTouCan1 repository, which contained 253,596 entries before filtering. After excluding entries linked to downstream tasks and applying sequential structural filtering, 167,020 samples remained and were used for pretraining. Pretraining comprised nine self-supervised tasks. Results: Benchmarking on the GlycanML dataset demonstrates that GlycanPUG shows competitive performance relative to GlycanGT across multi-label taxonomy classification and binary immunogenicity prediction. Crucially, on datasets natively containing structural uncertainties (GlyCosmos, GlyConnect), GlycanPUG effectively processes additional structurally ambiguous entries, achieving 83.5% processable coverage across all glycans from all biological sources in GlyCosmos, with taxonomic classification performance (e.g., mean macro F1 of 0.7376 for Domain). Ablation of the node pre-enhancement module reduces macro F1, and post-hoc analysis identifies rank-dependent associations between structural uncertainty and prediction errors. All results reported above are averaged over ten independent random seeds (1-10). Conclusions: GlycanPUG broadens the set of glycans that can be represented while retaining supported structural ambiguities.
zh_abstract: 【背景】聚糖调控多种生物学过程，但与蛋白质和核酸相比，其在计算生物学中的代表性仍然不足。尽管 WURCS 2.0 提供了一种可保留不确定性的机器可读结构表示，但所评估的基于 IUPAC 的确定性工作流程仅能处理此处所检视的源自 GlyCosmos 的队列的 43.1%，这促使人们寻求能够保留结构模糊性的方法。【方法】为克服这一局限，引入了 GlycanPUG（Probabilistic Uncertainty-aware Graph，概率性不确定性感知图），作为用于聚糖表征学习的预训练图模型。GlycanPUG 借助 WURCS 2.0，在异质图框架内使用加权边和不确定性属性来表示候选连接和取代基连接。一个带有专用节点预增强模块的 4 层异质图神经网络（Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network）按所分配的边权重聚合边特征，从而能够表示受支持的结构模糊聚糖，而无需选择单一的确定结构。该模型在 GlyTouCan1 数据库经预处理的子集上进行预训练，该子集在过滤前包含 253,596 个条目。在排除与下游任务相关的条目并进行连续结构过滤后，剩余 167,020 个样本用于预训练。预训练包含九项自监督任务。【结果】在 GlycanML 数据集上的基准测试表明，在多标签分类学分类和二元免疫原性预测方面，GlycanPUG 相对于 GlycanGT 表现出具有竞争力的性能。关键的是，在天然含有结构不确定性的数据集（GlyCosmos、GlyConnect）上，GlycanPUG 能有效处理更多结构模糊的条目，在 GlyCosmos 中来自所有生物来源的全部聚糖上实现了 83.5% 的可处理覆盖率，并具有分类学分类性能（例如，Domain 的平均宏 F1 为 0.7376）。去除节点预增强模块会降低宏 F1，事后分析发现结构不确定性与预测错误之间存在依赖于排名的关联。上述所有结果均为十个独立随机种子（1-10）的平均值。【结论】GlycanPUG 在保留受支持的结构模糊性的同时，拓宽了可被表示的聚糖范围。

abstract: Background: White blood cell (WBC) classification across datasets is challenged by differences in staining, image context, and class distributions. Methods: We developed a two-stage YOLO11-Swin Transformer pipeline. In the first stage, WBC detection and context-preserving cropping, a YOLO11 detector finds the leukocyte in each uncropped image and produces a cell-focused crop that retains the surrounding background. In the second stage, WBC classification, a Swin Transformer (Swin-B) assigns the crop to one of nine cell types. The classifier was trained on detector-cropped cells from five public datasets, so the first stage supplies the same kind of input at test time; morphology-preserving color augmentation addressed staining variation, and class-weighted cross-entropy addressed class imbalance. WBCBench2026, a public benchmark not used for training, served for external evaluation in seven harmonized classes, scored by macro-F1 (the mean of per-class F1). Further analyses removed the first stage or masked the background, compared classifier backbones, held out each training dataset (leave-one-dataset-out, LODO), and tested a second split (Phase-2) with about 60% synthetically degraded images. Results: The full pipeline reached an external macro-F1 of 0.879{+/-}0.006 on 8,080 benchmark images. With uncropped images as input, the same crop-trained classifier reached 0.627{+/-}0.039, and crops that kept the surrounding background outperformed background-masked crops (0.867 versus 0.760). With identical detector-cropped input, Swin-B outperformed convolutional baselines (0.863 versus 0.718-0.813), and its advantage over ResNet50 persisted across three training configurations. In LODO, macro-F1 on the held-out dataset ranged from 0.59 to 0.91, revealing source-specific variation not fully covered by the remaining datasets. On Phase-2, macro-F1 was 0.769{+/-}0.002. Two hematologists independently reviewed all 205 blast- or promyelocyte-related model-benchmark disagreements and gave the same verdict on 73 crops (35.6%): 21 model right, 43 model wrong, 9 ambiguous. Conclusions: The proposed two-stage pipeline achieved strong cross-dataset WBC classification performance. Context-preserving cropping was essential for the crop-trained classifier, and the LODO findings support representing the same classes across diverse sources when developing robust WBC classifiers.
zh_abstract: 【背景】不同数据集之间的白细胞（WBC）分类面临染色、图像背景和类别分布差异的挑战。【方法】我们开发了一个两阶段的 YOLO11-Swin Transformer 流程。第一阶段为白细胞检测及保留背景的裁剪：YOLO11 检测器在每幅未裁剪图像中找到白细胞，并生成以细胞为中心、保留周围背景的裁剪图。第二阶段为白细胞分类：Swin Transformer（Swin-B）将裁剪图归入九种细胞类型之一。分类器在来自五个公开数据集的、经检测器裁剪的细胞上训练，因此第一阶段在测试时提供同类输入；保留形态的颜色增强用于应对染色差异，类别加权交叉熵用于应对类别不平衡。WBCBench2026 是未用于训练的公开基准，用于在七个统一后的类别上进行外部评估，以宏平均 F1（各类别 F1 的均值）评分。进一步的分析包括：去除第一阶段或遮蔽背景、比较分类器骨干网络、逐一留出每个训练数据集（留一数据集法，LODO），以及检验约 60% 图像经合成退化的第二种划分（Phase-2）。【结果】完整流程在 8,080 幅基准图像上的外部宏平均 F1 为 0.879±0.006。以未裁剪图像作为输入时，同一经裁剪图训练的分类器为 0.627±0.039；保留周围背景的裁剪图优于背景被遮蔽的裁剪图（0.867 对 0.760）。在相同的检测器裁剪输入下，Swin-B 优于卷积基线（0.863 对 0.718–0.813），且其相对于 ResNet50 的优势在三种训练配置下均持续存在。在 LODO 中，留出数据集上的宏平均 F1 为 0.59 至 0.91，显示出其余数据集未能完全覆盖的来源特异性差异。在 Phase-2 上，宏平均 F1 为 0.769±0.002。两名血液科医师独立复核了全部 205 例与原始细胞或早幼粒细胞相关的模型与基准不一致病例，对 73 个裁剪图（35.6%）给出相同判定：模型正确 21 个，模型错误 43 个，存在歧义 9 个。【结论】所提出的两阶段流程在跨数据集白细胞分类中取得了良好性能。对于经裁剪图训练的分类器，保留背景的裁剪至关重要；LODO 结果支持在开发稳健的白细胞分类器时，使相同类别由多样化来源共同代表。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] With the deep integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into public health and clinical care, challenges including dynamic algorithm iteration, data security risks, and ambiguous liability allocation pose multifaceted threats to traditional regulatory frameworks. Among these challenges, this study focuses specifically on the tension between static pre-market approval and the continuous iteration of AI-enabled medical systems. Globally, the European Union (EU), the United States (US), and Japan have developed distinct regulatory models that offer valuable lessons for China. This paper conducts a comparative analysis of medical AI regulatory logics and institutional practices across jurisdictions, with particular attention to algorithm modification, lifecycle oversight, and continuous post-market evaluation. Building on international experience, we propose an optimized institutional pathway for China that centers on differentiated algorithm-change control, continuous lifecycle evaluation, and risk-based regulatory adjustment, while treating liability allocation, risk classification, and data governance as supporting dimensions. This framework provides theoretical support and practical guidance for improving China's medical AI regulatory system, promoting standardized technology development, and supporting the orderly development of public health services in the digital health era.

abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] Continuous monitoring, timely intervention, and personalized long-term management are necessary for chronic diseases. Conventional healthcare systems often fail to assess patients' health status in real time. Cloud-edge-device collaborative computing combines Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices, edge computing, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence (AI) to enable distributed processing and remote healthcare delivery. This scoping review aimed to map the current evidence on the application of cloud-edge-device collaborative computing in the management of chronic diseases. The Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and the PRISMA Extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines were used in this scoping review. PubMed, Scopus, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, Embase, Google Scholar, and selected grey literature sources were searched from database inception to 1 July 2026, with results limited to studies published from 2000 onward. Original cloud-edge-device collaborative computing studies focused on chronic disease management were included, and data were analyzed narratively. Ten studies, including experimental implementations, system development studies, conceptual frameworks, and one randomized controlled trial published between 2015 and 2025, were included. Cloud-edge-device architectures were applied in the management of diabetes (n = 5), monitoring of cardiovascular disease (n = 1), management of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD; n = 1), and multi-disease/multi-morbidity applications (n = 3). IoMT devices continuously obtained physiological data, while edge/fog layers processed local data, reduced latency, and made real-time decisions. Cloud platforms stored and analyzed large-scale data and trained the models. Artificial intelligence methods, especially machine-learning algorithms, predicted and assessed disease risks. However, only one study was a clinical trial involving patients; most studies used benchmark datasets, volunteers, or simulations, meaning real-world clinical validation remains limited. Cloud-edge-device collaborative computing has been used to integrate distributed computing, IoMT, and AI for chronic disease management, but current evidence is mainly technical, and its clinical benefits remain largely unestablished.
zh_abstract: 慢性病需要持续监测、及时干预和个性化的长期管理。传统医疗系统往往无法实时评估患者的健康状况。云-边-端协同计算将医疗物联网（IoMT）设备、边缘计算、云计算和人工智能（AI）相结合，以实现分布式处理和远程医疗服务。本范围综述旨在梳理云-边-端协同计算应用于慢性病管理的现有证据。本范围综述采用 Joanna Briggs 研究所方法学和 PRISMA 范围综述扩展版指南。检索了 PubMed、Scopus、Cochrane 图书馆、Web of Science、Embase、Google Scholar 及部分灰色文献来源，检索时间自数据库建库起至 2026 年 7 月 1 日，结果限定为 2000 年及以后发表的研究。纳入以慢性病管理为重点的云-边-端协同计算原创研究，并对数据进行叙述性分析。共纳入 10 项研究，包括实验性实现、系统开发研究、概念框架以及 1 项随机对照试验，发表时间为 2015 年至 2025 年。云-边-端架构被应用于糖尿病管理（n = 5）、心血管疾病监测（n = 1）、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）管理（n = 1）以及多疾病/多重共病应用（n = 3）。IoMT 设备持续获取生理数据，边缘/雾层处理本地数据、降低延迟并做出实时决策。云平台存储和分析大规模数据并训练模型。人工智能方法，尤其是机器学习算法，用于预测和评估疾病风险。然而，仅有 1 项研究为纳入患者的临床试验；大多数研究使用基准数据集、志愿者或模拟，这意味着真实世界的临床验证仍然有限。云-边-端协同计算已被用于整合分布式计算、IoMT 和 AI 以进行慢性病管理，但目前的证据主要是技术层面的，其临床获益在很大程度上仍未得到证实。

abstract: Bioconductor provides standardized data structures and statistical methods for high-throughput genomic analysis in R, whereas Python has become a primary environment for machine learning, image analysis, and general-purpose data science. Combining tools across both ecosystems often requires ad-hoc file conversions or embedded language runtimes that can lose metadata, introduce maintenance overhead, or lead to subtle differences in downstream results. Here, we present BiocPy, a collection of Python packages that support cross-language genomic workflows through three complementary layers: (1) native Python implementations of Bioconductor's core data structures; (2) lossless data exchange via direct reading and writing of serialized R (.rds) objects and the language-neutral ArtifactDB format for persistent, multi-stage pipelines; and (3) a cross-platform method development paradigm built on shared C++ libraries wrapped across R, Python, and WebAssembly to support identical statistical analyses across environments. All packages in the BiocPy ecosystem are published to the Python Package Index (PyPI) with source code hosted at [https://github.com/BiocPy].
zh_abstract: Bioconductor 为 R 中的高通量基因组分析提供了标准化的数据结构和统计方法，而 Python 已成为机器学习、图像分析和通用数据科学的主要环境。在这两个生态系统之间组合使用工具，往往需要临时的文件转换或嵌入式语言运行时，这可能导致元数据丢失、增加维护负担，或使下游结果出现细微差异。在此，我们介绍 BiocPy，这是一个 Python 软件包集合，通过三个互补的层面支持跨语言基因组工作流程：（1）Bioconductor 核心数据结构的原生 Python 实现；（2）通过直接读取和写入序列化的 R（.rds）对象以及与语言无关的 ArtifactDB 格式，实现无损数据交换，以支持持久化的多阶段流程；（3）基于共享 C++ 库的跨平台方法开发范式，这些库被封装用于 R、Python 和 WebAssembly，以支持在不同环境中进行一致的统计分析。BiocPy 生态系统中的所有软件包均已发布到 Python 软件包索引（PyPI），源代码托管于 [https://github.com/BiocPy]。
